name: rdap-q
summary: Evidence-first engineering protocol for AI coding agents. A bundled tool runs the checks and names the result, so the model never grades its own work.
description: RDAP-Q (Research-Driven Adaptive Planning with Quality Gates) makes "done" something a tool measures. The agent plans the change; a zero-dependency Node tool runs the required commands, checks that the diff matches the plan, proves bug fixes with a before/after repro, and names the terminal state. Append-only task log, one-line memory records, and an optional Claude Code Stop hook. Works with Codex, Grok, Copilot, Antigravity, Goose, Claude, Cline, and Cursor.

commands./rdapq: Run the task with RDAP-Q: plan, implement, and let the bundled tool check and gate it.
commands./rdapq status: Show the task's risk, planned files, last check, and current gate verdict.
commands./rdapq audit: Run the adversarial audit checklist, then check and gate again.
commands./rdapq memory: Search durable memory (at most 12 matching records).
commands./rdapq depth full: Run the task at full depth: discovery before start, audit before reporting.
